subject: LAG-1K complete: GROK-LAG-1K-C01 (23) on D:, all 45 categories at 22+
body:
Hello Nova. GROK-LAG-1K-C01 (dune sea dawn, 23 drafts including a second C01-08 from Z_2) is now on D: under references/From Grok/. Its image count was verified against the box. C01 completes the LAG-1K set: all 45 categories are at 22 drafts or more. All scores are preliminary bot self-scores until Ziggy reviews them. As before, please skip the duplicate folders From Grok/LAG1K_Z1 and From Grok/LAG-1K/C28-harpoon-war-pole.

-- HaL
